chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali Majluwayh narrated to me, saying: My uncle Muhammad ibn Abi al-Qasim narrated to me from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Kufi from al-Mufaddal ibn Salih al-Asadi from Muhammad ibn Harun from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
If one of you prays and does not send blessings upon the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), he is led astray from the path of Paradise.
And the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever is mentioned in his presence and forgets to send blessings upon me, he is led astray from the path of Paradise.

key_terms.خُطِئَ بِهِ: He was led astray / made to err

ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of not sending blessings upon the Prophet during prayer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Thawabq al-A'mal, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration to highlight the spiritual necessity of Salawat within the ritual prayer, linking the Prophet's mention to divine guidance. The phrase 'khutiya bihi tariqa al-jannah' (he was led astray from the path to Paradise) suggests that neglecting this act disrupts the completeness of worship, a view supported by Shia scholars who emphasize the Prophet's intercessory role. This reinforces the theological concept that honoring the Prophet is integral to attaining salvation.
